ideas.description: Exploit: buy margin, as the H4 gate requires before any further time cut. On the E036 tip (231 steps at batch 2000), change only the step count to 9.5 true epochs (237 steps), adding 0.25 epoch. Keep the 20/24/28/32 px phases (30/10/30/30), the LR triangle, the Lookahead ramp, the whitening-bias detach (20%) and the group-1 freeze (75%) as fractions of the new total, as in E023/E027/E034. No new shapes, so no recapture is needed; error_on_recompile stays on. Run it in ONE build session: (a) E036 unchanged on seeds 13–32, a fresh same-build baseline that I075 and later ideas reuse; (b) this recipe on seeds 13–32; (c) ar.py on seeds 0–2. Keep if the 20-seed mean is ≥0.7545 and seeds 0–2 are ≥0.753 in this build. Also record the measured s/pp so the post-freeze dial gets re-priced for every later booster and cut. Do not re-roll RNG streams.
ideas.expected: Time +0.12 to +0.17 s (to about 5.43–5.48 s, +2.5–3%), because part of the added work lands in cheap frozen 32 px steps. The 20-seed mean rises 0.06–0.15 pp over same-build E036 (median +0.10, to about 0.7545). That puts the post-freeze dial at about 1.0–2 s/pp. A gain under 0.05 pp means the dial has flattened near the tip, so margin must come from structure (H1.7) instead.

ideas.description: Exploit, the decisive test of the E046 crux (W2/W3/W5/W6). On the E036 tip, apply E046's group-2 freeze exactly as committed in 8a2452a. Group-2 filters and BN params get their own groups, with LR annealed from 75% to 0 at 90% of steps. For the last 10% of steps, group 2's output is detached before group 3, using the truncated 32 px variant. Group-2 BN stays in train mode and Lookahead averages every param. On top of that, add 0.25 true epoch (231 → 237 steps, all schedules kept as fractions). Capture the variants in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge in the same build session as I074, against the same-build E036 baseline and the I074 arm on seeds 13–32, plus seeds 0–2. Decision: if time is at least 2% below E036 and the 20-seed mean is within 0.03 pp of E036 or above it, the cascade-plus-top-up dominates E036 and becomes the base for further margin buying. If it trails the I074 arm by more than 0.15 pp, the group-2 freeze is no better than the dial and the cascade closes.
ideas.expected: Time about 5.18–5.24 s (−1.5 to −2.5% vs E036): E046's −0.23 s plus the top-up's +0.13 s. 20-seed mean −0.15 to +0.08 pp vs same-build E036 (median −0.03).

ideas.description: Exploit, systems only, with identical math. E047's whole-trial trace found about 135 ms (2.5%) of non-step GPU work: memcpy/copies 68 ms, interpolate 29 ms, augmentation gathers 20 ms, permutation indexing 12 ms. First, in an offline copy, attribute the 68 ms of copies with torch.profiler stack traces. Likely sources are cudagraph-tree copy-in of the augmented batch into static inputs, channels_last .contiguous() after interpolate, and the dataset index_select. Then remove them without changing any number. Have the crop/flip/interpolate path write directly into the step graph's static input buffer, or move augmentation inside the compiled step. Do the per-epoch permutation gather once per epoch as one batched gather instead of per-batch indexing. Drop redundant layout conversions. Before launching, check offline with torch.equal that every batch tensor equals the current one for seed 13. Capture in build, with error_on_recompile on. Keep on time alone if seeds 0–2 accuracies are bit-identical to the same-build baseline, or within rebuild noise if kernels were re-selected.
ideas.expected: Time −0.03 to −0.08 s (−0.5 to −1.5%, to about 5.24–5.29 s). Accuracy unchanged per seed. If the copies turn out to be the cudagraph's own unavoidable parameter or static-input traffic (saving <0.5%), close the non-step systems branch for good.

ideas.description: Explore, the structural sample-efficiency lever H1 calls for. It is cheaper than H1.7.1's widening, which would add about 7% time (E010's 576→512 saved 4.8%). On the E036 tip, add a fourth 3×3 conv (512→512, BN, GELU) to group 3's residual branch after conv3 and before the residual add. It runs on 3×3 maps at 32 px (2–3 px at lower resolutions), where E047 measured the convs at about 1.1 ms fwd+bwd per 32 px step. Give it Dirac init like the others so it starts near identity. Initialize it after the existing layers so their init RNG draws are unchanged. It joins the Muon group, with the same wd and LR schedule, and is averaged by Lookahead. Recapture every resolution and variant in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against the same-build E036 baseline (I074's session if available), plus seeds 0–2. Booster rule: worth keeping if the gain is ≥ Δtime / (I074's measured s/pp).
ideas.expected: Time +0.12 to +0.20 s (+2.5–4%). 20-seed mean −0.05 to +0.30 pp (median +0.10). A gain of ≥0.15 pp at ≤+3% supports H1.7 (late capacity is the CIFAR-100 bottleneck) and beats the dial. A gain of ≤0.05 pp refutes the late-capacity reading and leaves epochs as the only booster.

ideas.description: Explore, the memory-bound share (27% of the 32 px step, E043). On the E036 tip, replace GELU with ReLU in all conv groups. If any activation sits before group 1 or in the head, leave it unchanged. Nothing else changes. Inspect Inductor's saved tensors offline first: record whether ReLU's backward saves a bool mask or the fp16 output, since that sets the bytes saved. Recapture every resolution and variant in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against the same-build E036 baseline, plus seeds 0–2. This settles whether the fused BN/activation kernels are bytes-bound (activation type irrelevant) or compute-sensitive (GELU's erf costs time).
ideas.expected: Time −0.5 to −3% (median −1.2%). 20-seed mean −0.4 to 0 pp (median −0.15), since GELU usually beats ReLU in short runs. Supports H6.5.1 only if time falls ≥3% with ≤0.15 pp loss. A saving under 1% shows the fused kernels are bytes-bound and closes the activation branch of H6.5.

drop.reason: E047 settled this: conv1 (Cin=24) runs at about 0.45x group-2 efficiency but costs only 6–9% of a 32 px step, with dgrad already skipped after the whitening detach. That is below H6.4.1's 10% bar. Padding to Cin=32 adds 33% of conv1's MACs, and all four committee members forecast no improvement (0/4 improve votes).

structured_output.summary: The tip (E036, 5.31 s) has an unselected 20-seed mean of about 0.7535 and clears the local 0.753 bar on only some builds. So the H4 gate makes buying margin the top priority. I074 (H4.2.6, priority 5) re-prices the post-freeze epoch dial: +0.25 epoch, judged on seeds 13–32 against a fresh E036 baseline from the same build session. Later ideas reuse that baseline. I075 (H2.6.9, priority 4) is the decisive test of the committee's shared E046 crux: the group-2 freeze plus a 0.25-epoch top-up, run in the same session. It should dominate E036 (about −2% time at equal accuracy) if group 2's freeze cost holds at −0.14 pp. I076 (H2.2, priority 3) goes after the 2.5% of non-step GPU work (copies, interpolate, gathers) that E047 found, with identical math. I077 (H1.7, priority 3, explore) adds a cheap Dirac-initialized fourth conv to group 3 at 3×3 maps. It tests whether late capacity is the structural sample-efficiency lever H1 says is the only remaining one. I078 (H6.5.1, priority 2, explore) swaps GELU for ReLU to test whether the 27% memory-bound share depends on the activation type. I073 is dropped because E047 refuted its premise (conv1 is 6–9% of a step, below the 10% bar). I072 (loss-based selection) is still running. Queue: 5 new ideas plus 1 running, about 2/3 exploit.
